title: Cut the Rope Mini
description: Time every physics rope slice to swing the striped candy through floating golden stars and drop it straight into your hungry little monster’s mouth.
controls: Swipe across taut ropes to slice them cleanly, collect floating stars along the swing arc, and feed the candy to the monster.

zh-CN.title: 割绳子
zh-CN.description: 国民级物理益智割绳子：算准摆动时机一刀划断绳索，借力收集沿途金星，把糖果稳稳送进小怪兽嘴里。
zh-CN.controls: 用手指或鼠标划过绳索即可切断，利用惯性收集星星并让糖果落入小怪兽口中。
